description: Defines the CustomerOption entity class with JPA annotations, representing customer options in the system, including properties like code, type, active status, and relationships to descriptions and merchant store.

classes.name: CustomerOption
classes.description: Entity class representing a customer option with properties, relationships, and JPA annotations.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the set of customer option descriptions.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the set of customer option descriptions.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the customer option.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the customer option.

methods.name: setDescriptionsList
methods.description: Sets the list of customer option descriptions.

methods.name: getDescriptionsList
methods.description: Returns the list of customer option descriptions.

methods.name: getDescriptionsSettoList
methods.description: Converts descriptions set to list if needed and returns it.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns whether the option is active.

methods.name: isPublicOption
methods.description: Returns whether the option is public.
